how_its_made:
Tithi.xyz is a cross-chain abstraction protocol that removes the friction of using multiple blockchains.
Instead of bridges, wrapped tokens, or switching wallets, users interact with one unified layer — and Tithi takes care of the routing, signing, and gas.

For developers, Tithi provides an SDK that exposes easy-to-use methods like:

tithi.send(fromChain, toChain, asset, amount)
tithi.swap(tokenA, tokenB, chain)


It’s built using Avail’s Nexus SDK, meta-transactions, and intent-based execution — designed to make interoperability effortless for everyone.
